name: @ant/ide
description: ANT IDE Server - using Docker openvscode-server

scripts.predev: docker ps -a | grep ant-openvscode && (docker stop ant-openvscode; docker rm ant-openvscode) || true
scripts.dev: docker run -d --name ant-openvscode --hostname ant-openvscode -p ${ANT_IDE_PORT:-4400}:3000 -v "${ANT_IDE_CODEBASE_PATH:-${ANT_WORKSPACE_BASE_PATH:-/Users/probe/dev/ant-workspaces}}:/workspace:cached" -w /workspace gitpod/openvscode-server && echo "✅ OpenVSCode Server started on http://localhost:${ANT_IDE_PORT:-4400} (mounted: ${ANT_IDE_CODEBASE_PATH:-${ANT_WORKSPACE_BASE_PATH:-/Users/probe/dev/ant-workspaces}} → /workspace)"
scripts.stop: docker stop ant-openvscode && docker rm ant-openvscode
scripts.build: echo 'No build step required for Docker-based IDE'
